newsitem.title: USA: Waste Recovery to buy out plant partner.
newsitem.headline: Waste Recovery to buy out plant partner.

text.p: Waste Recovery Inc said Tuesday it has signed a letter of intent with NIPSCO Industries Inc to buy out its partnership share in WRI/Illinois.
NIPSCO has a 55 percent interest in WRI/Illinois, a partnership between Waste Recovery and NIPSCO that operates two tire-derived fuel processing facilities in Illinois.
In return for its interest, NIPSCO will receive 1.1 million shares of Waste Recovery's common stock, and will be entitled to appoint a member to Waste Recovery's board of directors.
The two processing facilities are in Dupo and Marseilles, Illinois. They have a combined capacity to process 15 million tires per year into tire-derived fuel.
The deal is contingent on the executive of a definitive agreement, which is expected before the end of the year, the company said.
